//recipeOverrides: Per-recipe overrides go here, keyed by the recipe's EditorID. Setting "exclude": true prevents RCP from making any changes to that recipe, unless another config overrides it again. Example row: { "recipe": "TemperWeaponSteelSword", "exclude": true, "comment": "why you did this" }. Left empty by default; a row naming a recipe you don't have installed logs a warning on every load.
